key_insight: SIGMA accounts for finite-training-data uncertainty when validating generative models, helping distinguish genuine mismodeling from statistical estimation error.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty-aware validation can make generative density models more reliable for scientific workflows such as particle-physics background estimation.
method: Fit densities using Gaussian mixture models with tractable uncertainties.
Propagate fit uncertainties into a goodness-of-fit test as profiled nuisance parameters.
Replace an exact-model point-null test with an uncertainty-aware composite-null test.
evidence_signal: On a controlled 2D toy model and a collider QCD-background benchmark, including uncertainties allowed the same model to remain acceptable on test sets up to an order of magnitude larger than standard testing allowed.
watch_item: Reliable interpretation requires propagated uncertainties to faithfully cover fitting error; the demonstrated framework uses Gaussian mixture models.
paper_title: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
